title: Your first five reads
第一次来，从这五项开始
summary: Build a map of the field, understand a benchmark, follow a feedback loop, then examine an agent and its evaluation. This introductory route uses RTL as a concrete example.
先建立领域地图，再了解基准、反馈循环、Agent 工作流与评测。路线以 RTL 为具体例子，帮助理解整个领域。
prerequisites: Basic digital logic and Verilog terminology. Start by reading; these steps do not require installing EDA tools.
了解基本数字逻辑与 Verilog 术语。先阅读即可，无需为了这条路线安装 EDA 工具。

why: Get an overview before choosing a design direction.
先了解 LLM 在 EDA 中的位置，再选择具体研究方向。
focus: Identify generation, verification, and agentic workflows; note which problems interest you.
区分代码生成、验证和 Agent 工作流，记下自己关心的问题。

why: Understand what a generated design must pass before comparing methods.
在比较方法之前，先理解生成的设计要通过什么检查。
focus: Read the task descriptions and simulation-based functional evaluation; distinguish compiling from being correct.
看任务描述和基于仿真的功能评测，理解编译通过与功能正确的区别。

why: Learn a compiler-and-simulator feedback loop used to improve generated HDL.
理解利用编译器和仿真器反馈迭代改进 HDL 的基本循环。
focus: Trace generation, tool feedback, and revision; inspect the experimental setup before the reported scores.
沿着生成、工具反馈、修改的顺序阅读，先看实验设置，再看结果。

why: See how planning and waveform tracing extend a generation loop into an agent workflow.
了解规划和波形追踪如何将生成循环扩展为 Agent 工作流。
focus: Follow the roles of planning, simulation, and debugging, and the information passed between them.
关注规划、仿真与调试分别负责什么，以及它们之间传递什么信息。

why: Finish by examining evaluation beyond compilation.
最后了解超越编译通过的评测视角。
focus: Compare functional equivalence, completeness, and QoR; record the tools and conditions behind each result.
比较功能等价、模块完整性和 QoR，并记录各项结果依赖的工具与条件。
